scripts.fixtures: python3.12 scripts/generate_fixture_wav.py --check && python3.12 scripts/verify_fixture_corpus.py && python3.12 scripts/verify_env_example.py
scripts.test: npm run fixtures && npm run test:backend && npm run test:client
scripts.test:backend: cd services/api && PROVIDER_MODE=fixture ALLOW_REMOTE_PROVIDER_CALLS=false FIXTURE_ROOT=../../fixtures .venv/bin/python -m pytest
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:client && npm run typecheck
scripts.lint:backend: services/api/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check services/api/app services/api/tests services/api/alembic
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint && npm run export:web
scripts.web: python3.12 scripts/with_config.py -- npm --prefix apps/client run web
scripts.export:web: python3.12 scripts/with_config.py -- npm --prefix apps/client run export
scripts.prebuild: python3.12 scripts/with_config.py -- npm --prefix apps/client run prebuild -- --no-install
scripts.migrate: mkdir -p services/api/data && cd services/api && .venv/bin/python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.compose:up: npm run fixtures && npm run compose:config && python3.12 scripts/compose.py up --build
